mapper.delete: DELETE FROM execution_daily_stat WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND stat_date = #{statDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO execution_daily_stat (stat_date, project_id, test_team, exec_type, executed_count, success_count, fail_count) SELECT #{statDate}, l.project_id, MAX(p.test_team), l.exec_type, COUNT(*), SUM(l.result = '成功'), SUM(l.result = '失败') FROM case_execution_log l JOIN project p ON p.id = l.project_id WHERE l.project_id = #{projectId} AND l.exec_date = #{statDate} GROUP BY l.project_id, l.exec_type
